mapper.insert: insert into member ( userid, userpw, username, nickname, email, gender, toplct_id, detail_address, profile_img, seller_status, provider, enable_flag, agree_terms_required, agree_privacy_required, agree_location_optional, agree_marketing_email, agree_marketing_sms ) values ( #{userid}, #{userpw}, #{username}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{toplct_id}, #{detail_address}, 'default_profile.png', 'N', 'LOCAL', '1', #{agree_terms_required}, #{agree_privacy_required}, #{agree_location_optional}, #{agree_marketing_email}, #{agree_marketing_sms} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.userid, m.userpw, m.username, m.nickname, m.email, m.gender, m.toplct_id, m.detail_address, m.profile_img, m.seller_status, m.provider, m.enable_flag, m.regdate, m.updatedate, m.deleted_at, m.agree_terms_required, m.agree_privacy_required, m.agree_location_optional, m.agree_marketing_email, m.agree_marketing_sms, a.auth FROM member m LEFT JOIN member_auth a ON m.userid = a.userid WHERE m.userid = #{userid}
mapper.update: update member set profile_img = #{profile_img}, updatedate = now() where userid = #{userid}
update member set nickname = #{nickname}, toplct_id = #{toplct_id}, detail_address = #{detail_address}, email = #{email} where userid = #{userid}
mapper.insert: insert into update_member_history (userid, changed_field, old_value, new_value, changed_by) values (#{userid}, #{changed_field}, #{old_value}, #{new_value}, #{changed_by})
mapper.update:
update member set nickname = (select old_value from update_member_history where userid = #{userid} and changed_field = 'nickname' order by changed_at asc limit 1),
toplct_id = (select old_value from update_member_history where userid = #{userid} and changed_field = 'toplct_id' order by changed_at asc limit 1),
detail_address = (select old_value from update_member_history where userid = #{userid} and changed_field = 'detail_address' order by changed_at asc limit 1),
email = (select old_value from update_member_history where userid = #{userid} and changed_field = 'email' order by changed_at asc limit 1) where userid = #{userid}
update member set enable_flag = '0', deleted_at = now() where userid = #{userid}
